name: Bunkasai 2 Ayanokouji no Gyakushuu
original_name: 文化祭2 綾小路の逆襲
source:
Main character is a very popular student at school. Classmate girls seek his attention, teachers and nurse invite him to discuss important matters. At this cultural festival all opportunities are open for him. What will he do?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-june-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
